messages:
alice_oncall: paging — p99 > 6.2s and 5xx rate climbing to 4.8% for inference-service right after canary deploy. Canary is v2.4.1 in us-west2. tagging @ben_sre @maya_runtime :rotating_light:
incidence-bot: ALERT: 5xx rate increased by 420% in last 2m for service=inference-service, region=us-west2, env=prod. Trigger: latency_thresholds.p99. Pager routed to alice_oncall.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for inference-service v2.4.1 started 3m ago — 10% traffic in us-west2. Commit: 3f9a2d7.
ben_sre: confirming — seeing increased connect/timeouts from frontends to runtime pods. tails: connection reset + context deadline. Dumping a small sample:
```
{"ts":"2024-03-17T19:03:12Z","err":"context deadline exceeded","route":"/generate","latency_ms":6203}
{"ts":"2024-03-17T19:03:14Z","err":"5xx from runtime","code":502}
```
maya_runtime: looking at GPU hosts — no OOMs, but backend queue length spiked on some canary replicas, KV cache misses jumped ~3x. Could be model variant radix causing longer kv lookups.
alice_oncall: customers are reporting timeouts on streaming endpoints — Jordan, any customer-facing impact yet?
jordan_pm: getting 3 short chats from two mid-market customers. CS triage says degraded UX but no billing hits yet. We should keep them in the loop if rollback takes >15m.
ben_sre: immediate mitigation — pause canary traffic and shift traffic back to v2.4.0 (stable). maya, can you abort canary and force container restart on canary replicas?
maya_runtime: aborting canary traffic now: `kubectl set image deployment/inference-service canary=@v2.4.0 --namespace=prod` and `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-service-canary -n prod` — doing sequential restarts with 10s stagger.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic paused. Routing policy reverted: 100% -> v2.4.0 in us-west2.
ben_sre: monitoring telemetry — watch p95/p99 and 5xx. If errors drop within 2m we call this quick revert and follow up with a postmortem.
alice_oncall: p95 down to 420ms, p99 down to 1.1s, 5xx back to 0.6% in 90s.
jordan_pm: filing brief customer note: "We observed a brief service degradation tied to a canary rollout; we've reverted to a stable version and are investigating. Will update in 2h."
maya_runtime: logs indicate the canary image included a new tokenizer sharder that triggers extra KV lookups for short prompts. Reproduced locally with load — p99 jumps for short sequences.
ben_sre: next steps: pin v2.4.0 for the night, create a small test that exercises short-prompt path, and run extended canary in staging with KV cache warmup.
alice_oncall: creating incident report and tagging oncall rotation. Assigning follow-up to @maya_runtime and @ben_sre for RCA. Closing live incident, will wait for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
